Earn chip / hints

Small prompts encouraging training participation and token-style rewards where enabled.

What this is

Earn chips and small hints encourage training participation and may reference token bonuses when campaigns are active.

How to use it

  • Read the chip; dismiss if you are not interested.
  • Follow the linked flow to complete training.
  • Chips respect local dismissal flags until reset.

Notes and limits

Bonus token rules and qualification requirements are described in Training and bonus tokens.
